profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Anaconda
profile.summary: Experienced User Interface Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Javascript/TypeScript (Angular/Vue/React), CSS (SASS/LESS), responsive design, user experience, Sketch, and Photoshop. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Technology Management from Texas A&M University.
